sources.title: John Watrous, The Theory of Quantum Information, Cambridge University Press (2018), author-hosted prepublication text
sources.read_locator: Complete relevant sections inspected in the full 598-page PDF: density operators/channels/Kraus and Stinespring interfaces; entropy and support-sensitive relative entropy; joint convexity and the full Theorem 5.35 channel-monotonicity proof; finite cq states, Holevo information, and the accessible-information bound.
sources.extent: Full author-hosted book PDF and extracted text. The book uses base-2 logarithms; local items use natural logarithms and nats and explicitly retain the factor conversion.
sources.support: Independent textbook treatment of finite quantum states, entropy, QRE, joint convexity, DPI, cq states, and Holevo measurement bounds. Local operator proofs are complete and do not substitute a citation for the proof.

contents.name: Finite-dimensional density operators and quantum channels
contents.detail: Ch. 2 supplies the finite state/channel setting; the local marginal lemma proves positivity and trace one for both factor orders under the repository convention.

contents.name: Von Neumann entropy and zero-eigenvalue convention
contents.detail: §5.2.1 supplies the spectral entropy formula; local definition fixes natural-log nats and omits zero-eigenvalue terms.

contents.name: Support-sensitive quantum relative entropy
contents.detail: §5.2.1 supplies the support condition and spectral trace formula; the local definition states the PSD extension and +infinity branch explicitly.

contents.name: Support containment for a bipartite state and its marginals
contents.detail: §5.2.2 supplies the product-marginal support context; the local kernel argument proves the exact inclusion and finite-QRE consequence.

contents.name: Entropy-form quantum mutual and conditional information
contents.detail: §§5.2.1–5.2.2 supply the finite entropy conventions; local definition fixes factor order and makes no conditional-entropy or CMI nonnegativity assertion.

contents.name: Quantum mutual information as relative entropy and the cq Holevo identity
contents.detail: §§5.2.2 and 5.3.3 give the identities; the local proof checks support inclusion and expands the block spectrum.

contents.name: Finite classical-quantum states and Holevo information
contents.detail: §5.3.3 supplies the ensemble and average-state formulas; local definition states the zero-probability convention.

contents.name: Inverse-compression resolvent and negative-log Jensen route
contents.detail: §5.2.3 motivates the operator-convexity route; the local proof establishes the inverse-compression estimate and resolvent integral directly.

contents.name: Relative modular representation
contents.detail: §5.2.3 uses the finite relative modular operator; the local matrix-unit proof checks its spectrum and trace identity.

contents.name: Support regularization and isometric invariance
contents.detail: §5.2.3 supplies the finite-QRE regularization context; local proof handles finite support inclusion and the infinite branch separately.

contents.name: Joint convexity of finite quantum relative entropy
contents.detail: §5.2.3 states joint convexity; the local proof supplies the direct-sum modular isometry argument and singular limit.

contents.name: Partial-trace and finite-channel data processing
contents.detail: Theorem 5.35 and its full proof were read; local items give an independent finite Weyl-twirl and Kraus-dilation proof.

contents.name: POVM as a finite classical-output channel
contents.detail: Ch. 2 channel/Kraus interfaces support the construction; local Kraus operators and normalization are calculated explicitly.

contents.name: Nonnegativity and equality for quantum relative entropy
contents.detail: Prop. 5.22 supports the claim; the local proof reduces through singleton and projective measurements to finite classical KL equality and polarization.

contents.name: Holevo measurement bound
contents.detail: §5.3.3 states the measurement bound; local proof applies channel DPI to each positive-probability ensemble branch.

sources.title: Mark M. Wilde, From Classical to Quantum Shannon Theory, arXiv:1106.1445v8
sources.read_locator: Complete 774-page book-length lecture notes and text extraction inspected. Read the finite quantum entropy and mutual-information definitions, QRE definition and DPI statement, Holevo chapter/exercise, Bell-pair conditional-entropy example, and the complete Ch. 12 §12.5 recoverability proof.
sources.extent: Full arXiv PDF and extracted text; relevant sections and complete cited recovery proof were inspected. The local statements use natural-log nats and finite-dimensional operators.
sources.support: Independent book-length treatment for finite entropy, relative entropy, mutual-information identities, cq ensembles and Holevo bounds. Wilde states QRE DPI in Ch. 11 and defers its proof; the local proof is complete and independent.

contents.name: Finite quantum entropy and mutual-information identities
contents.detail: §11.1 gives finite entropy and mutual-information conventions; the local definition fixes the repository linear-first convention and explicit marginals.

contents.name: Quantum relative entropy and its data-processing theorem statement
contents.detail: §11.8 supplies the support-sensitive definition and DPI statement; local items state and prove the finite PSD support branch.

contents.name: Holevo information for a finite cq ensemble
contents.detail: §§11.1 and 11.9 provide the finite cq/Holevo conventions; zero-probability labels are handled explicitly.

contents.name: Relative entropy identities for quantum mutual information
contents.detail: §§11.1 and 11.8 motivate the formulas; the local proof verifies the product-support condition and the finite block calculation.

contents.name: Holevo measurement-bound exercise
contents.detail: Exercise 11.9.2 states the measurement claim; its exercise status is not used as proof, since the local item supplies the complete DPI argument.

contents.name: Negative conditional entropy of a Bell pair
contents.detail: §11.7 supplies the entangled-state phenomenon; local verification computes the pure joint state and both reduced states.

contents.name: Quantitative recoverability strengthening of DPI
contents.reason: The assigned pair needs finite QRE channel data processing but no recovery map or near-equality theorem. The complete Ch. 12 §12.5 reasoning was inspected, and no recovery claim is imported.

contents.name: Entropy of a diagonal qubit state
contents.detail: The eigenvalue formula and p=0,1,1/2 cases are checked directly with the local 0 ln 0 convention.

contents.name: An orthogonal ensemble attains its Holevo information
contents.detail: The mixture spectrum and projective measurement law are calculated for an arbitrary finite probability vector.

contents.name: Normalized states with failed support inclusion have infinite QRE
contents.detail: Orthogonal pure states explicitly witness the support-failure branch of the local QRE definition.

contents.name: Bell pair with negative conditional entropy
contents.detail: The partial traces are evaluated from the finite tensor-basis formula.
